features.apple: MainMenu: File > New Reminder; toolbar add

features.feature: New list with name, colour, icon
features.apple: MainMenu: File > New List; badge emblem picker

features.feature: Built-in smart lists: Today, Scheduled, Flagged, All, Completed
features.note: View > Show Smart List hides or shows each smart list tile; the choice is kept while the app runs; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Save the hidden smart lists with the settings so they survive a restart (Options is held in memory only), and check the View menu merge on Midget.

features.feature: Custom smart lists with filters (date, time, priority, tags, lists, flag)
features.apple: ListDetailFilterEditor nib + strings; File > Create Smart List, Convert to Smart List
features.note: File > New Smart List form with date, time of day, priority, flag, one tag and one list rule; sidebar section with counts; Show List Info edits or deletes; the rules cycle on tap instead of using pickers; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Allow several tags with any/all and several lists with include/exclude, add a Convert to Smart List item, and give the form real pickers (a calendar for a date range) instead of cycling rows.

features.note: Detail editor and quick entry

Reminder > Mark as Urgent and an Urgent Alarm switch in the details; after the due moment the alert repeats every minute for up to a day or until completed; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: A persistent alarm that survives the notification being dismissed needs a shell alarm service; today it is a repeating notification, so add that service call in alerts.rs apply().

features.feature: Due date, time, early reminder, alerts
Subtasks: indent, outdent, show/hide all subtasks
features.apple: Reminder > Indent/Outdent Reminder; View > Show/Hide All Subtasks
features.note: Reminder > Indent and Outdent (Cmd+] and Cmd+[) on the selected reminder; View > Hide All Subtasks and Show All Subtasks; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Keep the collapsed state between runs, and apply Indent and Outdent to several selected reminders once the list has multi-select.

features.feature: Sort by manual, due, priority, title, creation date
features.note: Creation Date sort (oldest first; reminders made before 1.14.0 count as the oldest) and a View > Sort By submenu with the current order checked; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Save the sort choice between runs; it is held in memory and starts at Manual.

features.feature: Group by (none, due, priority, list, time)

features.apple: File > New Section, New Section with Selection; Reminder > Move to Section; Edit Sections
features.note: List > New Section, Reminder > Move to Section, a tap on a section header renames or deletes it, drag a reminder onto another section, sections written and read as Markdown headings; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Add New Section with Selection and an Edit Sections form to reorder sections; sections keep the order they were made in.

features.note: List > New List Group and Edit Group; groups are collapsible sections of the sidebar and a list joins one from the Group row of its form; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Drag a list onto a group in the sidebar and reorder groups.

features.apple: File > Pin List; AppIntents: Pinned Lists
features.note: List > Pin List / Unpin List and a Pin in Sidebar switch in the list form add a tile beside the smart lists (up to eight); built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Add a context item on the sidebar row, drag to reorder pinned tiles, and wire the Pinned Lists App Intent.

features.apple: Edit > Add Tag; learn-more tags window

features.note: A menu bar extra with New Quick Reminder and Add Reminder from Clipboard, which reads the text through quick::parse into the default list; there is no free-typing panel; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Open a text-entry panel from the menu bar extra; it needs a panel API for status items, which today offer menu entries only.

features.feature: Mark due date as Today/Tomorrow/This Weekend/Next Week; all overdue to today
features.apple: Reminder > Mark Due Date As; Mark All Overdue to Today
features.note: Reminder > Mark Due Date As (Today, Tomorrow, This Weekend, Next Week) on the selected reminder and Mark All Overdue as Today, each one undo step; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Apply Mark Due Date As to several selected reminders once the list has multi-select.

features.feature: Reorder reminders and lists by drag

features.note: File > Import List reads a Markdown checklist (subtasks, due days and section headings) into a new list through the open panel; Export List still writes the same format; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Register a document type in the manifest so a checklist file opens in Reminders from Files (Input::Open), and offer Save As for a list.

features.feature: Templates: save as template, view templates
features.apple: File > Save as Template, View Templates; templates placeholder nib
features.note: List > Save List as Template, New List from Template and Delete Template; a template keeps titles, notes, flags and priority without dates or completion; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Add a Templates sheet that previews a template's reminders before creating a list; templates are chosen from a submenu today.

features.apple: Share List; Manage Shared List; Assign
features.note: Needs the vendor cloud sharing service
Needs location hardware and geofencing service
File > Print List sends the list's Markdown checklist text, sections as headings, to the print path as Notes does; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Print smart lists and search results as well, and lay the printout out as a page rather than plain checklist text.

features.feature: Shortcuts intents: create reminder, create list, open list, open smart list, search, quick reminder
features.note: Add Reminder, Add Quick Reminder, Create List, Open List, Open Smart List and Search Reminders; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Add the Pinned Lists entity and a Show Quick Reminder intent that opens a quick-entry panel.

features.note: List > Auto-Categorize puts loose reminders into grocery sections (Produce, Dairy and Eggs, Bakery and so on) from whole words of the title and reuses sections of the same name; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: The English keyword table is fixed; learn from the user's moves between sections and offer categories beyond groceries.

features.feature: Rich text in reminder notes (bold, lists)
features.wire: Markdown rendering of the notes field in view.rs and Format menu items.

features.note: Add Image in the details opens a file panel for a PNG or JPEG (up to four, 12 MB each), copies it beside the store, shows thumbnails and a count on the row; Cancel deletes what was added; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Add a photo library picker and drag and drop onto the form, a full-size preview, and removing any picture (only the last one can go today); formats other than PNG and JPEG.

features.note: A Time Zone row in the details (twelve zones in turn, then Same as Device); the due time and the alert are read on that zone's clock with its daylight saving; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Replace the cycling row with a searchable picker over every zone of the system database.

features.feature: Settings: default list, all-day alert time, badge
features.note: Reminder > Settings (Cmd+,) form with the list new reminders go to, the all-day alert time (ten times from 6:00 to 20:00) and a Dock badge switch, saved in settings.tsv and followed by the alerts and the Today widget; built on parity/team-d-reminders; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Show the pane in the shell's Settings window or a real preferences window and offer any all-day time, not ten choices.
